coordinateSpace: 800x480 page pixels; little-endian RGB565 decoded by the named native LZO helper
observations: For Alpha128, sampled inside-cell background is blended; sampled internal lines and frame remain black (0x0000).
m_hnumberspin=3/m_Vnumberspin=2 produces three row bands and two column bands in this specimen.
limit: Named specimen and point samples only; no all-alpha or all-line-style claim.

pointRoles.200,120: Vertical inner line in the two-column specimen
pointRoles.120,133: First horizontal inner line in the three-row specimen
pointRoles.120,167: Second horizontal inner line in the three-row specimen
pointRoles.120,166: Pixel immediately above the second horizontal inner line
pointRoles.120,150: Default four-row central line; inside a cell in the three-row specimen
